label: Получить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for получить (to get, to receive).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 'Получу' is the 1sg simple future of perfective получить, with the regular ч stem before -у. The imperfective partner is получать.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Получишь' shows the -ишь ending of получить. 'Подарок завтра' names a single completed event to come.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person. 'Получит' is the -ит form of получить, marking one completed result. 'Скоро' anchors the near future.

missions.phrase: Мы получим новые документы в среду.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Получим' carries the -им ending of получить. 'Новые документы в среду' fixes the completed acquisition.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, polite or plural. 'Получите' trains the -ите form of получить. 'Письмо очень скоро' makes a natural reassurance.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Получат' closes the person ladder with the -ат ending after the hushing ч. 'Дипломы летом' fixes the event.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. 'Получил' is the completed masculine past of получить with the -л suffix. 'Важное сообщение' is the accusative thing received.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, feminine. 'Получила' adds the feminine -ла ending of получить. 'Хорошие новости' marks a single completed receipt.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, plural. 'Получили' is the plural -ли past of получить. Contrast this one finished act with the repeated imperfective получать.
Strategic focus: Perfective imperative, singular. 'Получи' is the command form of получить. 'Наконец свой паспорт' makes a complete, pressing instruction to one listener.
